about: What the range test is fed. The takes are Pablo's voice: they stay in scalita_app/test/detector/takes (takesDir, relative to this file, or SCALITA_TAKES) and are read in place; the composed WAVs go to SCALITA_SCRATCH or the temp folder, never here. Times are seconds into each take. The held G2 of 17-46-22 locks at only some window phases, so it is sung four times with gaps that move it a quarter window each time at 44.1 and 48 kHz; 18-50-13 locks its G4 at every phase.

twoTakes.sung: a held G2 from take-2026-08-28T17-46-22 (four times), then the 5-4-3-2-1 of take-2026-08-28T18-50-13 from G4

tones.sung: sine tones: 55 Hz (under the 65 Hz floor, read as fry), A3, then F#6 (whistle) and A5
